_doc: ONE PROGRESSION SYSTEM for the player and villagers (Steve 2026-10-14: 'I think we need to sync the player and villager system. But the villager system sounds like the better model.'). Deeds feed track XP; crossing a threshold is a level-up. Player and villagers alike get a level-up sheet: pick 1 of the next 3 unheld kit abilities (villagers pick by buildScore, src/js/villager-build.js; full slots = swap or keep). Villagers also learn the next track skill. Kits are MAGIC ONLY (lane 'magic'); human competences are the 'skills' lists (villagers learn them as skills, never in a slot). Read by src/js/tracks.js.
_thresholds: ONE XP SCALE for the player and every villager (Steve 2026-10-14: 'Villagers and players should get the same XP, when in doubt we treat them the same way.'). Same thresholds, same per-deed credit, same per-day caps; no player-only multiplier. Tuned so a median 150-day capable-bot run gives the player ~8 level-ups (evidence/2026-10-14/parity.md).
_kits: Power order, weakest first; the god-path subclass abilities (2026-10-14) sit after the originals and surface through the path lean (godpath.js shapeOffers). Interleaving kits by path for class diversity was measured and not kept: it cost the village (more combat deaths on 32 seeds) for +1-2 subclasses formed, because the early entries are the ones that keep people alive (evidence/2026-10-14/godpath-buff.md). Every magic ability sits in exactly one kit (fusion_reactor excluded: one per world, its own pellet offer). Everyone is offered the next 3 unheld.
_skills: Human competences the track's work teaches a VILLAGER (lane 'skill' ability ids; stored by their codex skill id). One per threshold crossed, no slot, no System needed. The player learns skills through the codex/practice paths instead.
_skillLevels: Villagers learn a track skill only at these levels (2 and 4): the old kits gave one thing per threshold, and merged skills carry several abilities (track_read = tracker + game_sense + blood_trail), so a skill at every level made villager godhood pools trivial. Order puts the godhood cores first (diplomat, triage/field_medicine) so shepherd_of_the_dead and undying_ward stay reachable.
_deeds: ONE deed table for everyone: creditDeed(who, id) credits {track, n} to whoever did it (the player or a villager), at most perDay times a day per doer (chores are decisions, not grinding). Same deed, same XP. noteDeed(id) = creditDeed('player', id).
_conversions: Deeds that used to GRANT a magic ability directly (trial-deeds, practice-deeds) now credit track XP once instead: the power comes from the track's level-up sheet.
